source: Pew Research Center. 2014. "Religion in Latin America: Widespread Change in a Historically Catholic Region."
method: Population is respondent's own current religion (QCURRELrec), pooled across all 18 Latin American/Caribbean countries and Puerto Rico. Share answering "yes" to Q63e ("Do you personally consider Mormons to be followers of the Christian faith, or not?"); don't know/refused excluded, "never heard of group" retained as a valid non-yes response rather than treated as missing. Weighted by the dataset's own combined base/post-stratification WEIGHT.
